scope.summary: Implement StudioComponent (hsk.studio.component@1) as the single canonical reusable-definition primitive that subsumes both the component and the symbol, created from a StudioSelectionSet of one or more StudioLayer nodes. Support single-component creation (whole selection -> one main component) and bulk creation (one component per selected top-level node) in one typed command. No source product name ('component','symbol','master') is a Studio type or command name.
acceptance_criteria: StudioComponent created single + bulk from selection; one canonical primitive; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: create-component action reachable via stable author_id; single + bulk paths
test: single creates one main component from selection; bulk creates one component per top-level node in one command

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Creating components from a selection

risk_if_missed: No component authoring; the whole design-system reuse model has no source definitions.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
